data.name: Randy
data.gender_notes: Randy is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'rand', meaning 'little one' or 'ready'. In medieval times, it was also a nickname for Ranulf or Randolph, derived from the Old Norse 'rani', meaning 'shield' or 'wolf counsel'. Randy can be interpreted as a symbol of readiness and preparedness for life. The name Randy carries the meaning “Little one, ready” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Randy usually hope their child will grow to embody little one, ready and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Randy is a name that represents readiness and preparation. It is a name that encourages individuals to be prepared for the challenges of life and to be ready for whatever comes their way.

in_greek.name: Ράνδη
in_greek.long_meaning: Ράνδη, φέρετρα, δίαιτα, προέρχονται από την αρχαία ελληνική λέξη 'ράνος' που σημαίνει 'φάγος', 'σαρκικός', ενώ το 'δένδρον' αναφέρεται στο δέντρο της ζωής. Στην πρώιμη χριστιανική εκκλησία, το όνομα Ράνδη χρησιμοποιήθηκε για να περιγράψει τον άνθρωπο που ζει μια ζωή σαρκικής ευδαιμονίας.

in_latin.name: Randy
in_latin.long_meaning: Randy, radix, denarius, vita, proveniente dalla radice latina 'randus' che significa 'radice', 'origine', mentre il 'denarius' si riferisce al denaro. Nella prima chiesa cristiana, il nome Randy fu utilizzato per descrivere l'uomo che vive una vita di vita radicata nella fede.
